# Practice readiness production composition

The Practice readiness resolver must receive the same PostgreSQL Store for its
frozen route and immutable readiness receipts. Student supplies current objective
mastery through the existing query port. Missing receipt storage must deny the
command before querying mastery; it cannot fabricate READY.

`newPracticeLearningResolver` in `cmd/ms-go-learning-planner/main.go` is the shared
production construction exercised by composition regression tests. It binds
`Readiness: store` alongside the existing route, catalog and policy dependencies. Reconciliation
uses the existing private route, dedicated Practice credential, request and receipt
schemas, and mastery/confidence policy. No graph-readiness or onboarding flag is
involved.

A new reconciliation key records current NOT_READY or READY. An exact retry
returns its original immutable receipt before rereading Student. Reusing that key
with a changed semantic body returns conflict. Reconciliation never rewrites the
frozen route, including its original readiness decision.

## Verification

The database-free tests check production repository composition and missing
dependency denial. `TestPracticeReadinessProductionPostgresLifecycle` uses the
same production factory, registered private HTTP handler and actual PostgreSQL
route, catalog, policy and receipt adapters. It covers NOT_READY then READY,
changed-mastery exact replay, key conflict, receipt readback, separate-pool
reconstruction, and an unchanged frozen route. Registered-handler checks also
verify that missing receipt storage or a missing/wrong Practice credential creates
no receipt and performs no Student mastery read. Fresh UUIDs avoid deleting immutable
receipts across repeated runs.

The test requires `T07_READINESS_TEST_DATABASE_URL` pointing to an owned database
whose name starts with `remediation_t07_` and ends with `_test`. The coordinator
creates/migrates the isolated database before running tests. Required existing
migrations are 001/002 for policy, 003 for routes, 004 for the canonical target,
and 016 for receipts; applying migrations 001–017 satisfies these requirements.
The test itself neither creates databases nor runs migrations. Without the
environment variable, the PostgreSQL test skips and proves no live persistence.

```sh
go test -count=1 -v ./cmd/ms-go-learning-planner -run '^TestPracticeReadiness'
```

The named `t07StudentMasteryFixture` exercises the Student query port; this is
Planner composition plus real PostgreSQL verification, not full Student evidence
or mastery E2E, Practice Runtime E2E, or learner-platform E2E.
